text:
Ravi: Quick update: we need to reorder the all-hands. Legal takes the slot at T0 for 12m, so Roadmap Q&A moves after leadership updates. Also recording test showed audio drift on the host.
Maya: Ok — thanks for the heads up. Can we get a 5m buffer after Legal for transitions?
Olivia: Yes, please. Also captions lagged last time. Ops can we pre-warm the STT model?
ops-bot: preflight: encoder_temp=65C, frames_dropped=1, captions_warm=false, local_rec_ready=true
Samir: I'll pre-warm captions now and start a local fallback recorder. If frame drops exceed 5% for 30s we flip to local-only and pause for 60s.
Maya: Add a slide at the top noting possible 1-min caption delay so attendees know.
Ravi: Good call. Olivia, can you notify presenters about the timing shift?
Olivia: Done — just messaged them and updated the agenda in Confluence: https://confluence/redwood/all-hands/today.
ops-bot: captions_warmup=started, expected_ready_in=28s
Samir: local recorder started: /recordings/allhands_1918050000.mkv. Kicking watcher: monitor-enc --pid 9921 --thr 5 --win 30s.
Maya: ACTIONS: Samir to monitor and upload to S3 after; Olivia to update slides and ping presenters; Ravi to capture follow-up notes. Everyone standby 5m before go.
